description: Fleet-shape response check for COVID-SUSCPOOL-V1: coarse generic-voyage cells at the five THETA-SCREEN-V13 admissible Thetas under the same four arms as the parent replay assay. A hard non-susceptible fraction shrinks the challengeable pool roughly in proportion to (1 - f), so fleet medians are expected to sag below their v13 rows and the band to shift upward in Theta -- this design measures the direction and magnitude class of that shift at 50 seeds per row. It is NOT a re-admission: no selector verdict is taken and no Theta is admitted from this surface; it points a follow-on re-screen design where to look if the parent's clause verdict calls for one.
prerequisites: covid_susc_pool_v1 (parent): the clause-response replay assay this fleet check accompanies -- same arms, same image, same campaign submission.
THETA-SCREEN-V13 measured (edb7fc41): the admissible band {1.78e11..5.62e11} this response check is centered on; the v13 stage-1 rows at these Thetas are the comparator of record.
voyage_mode_note: Generic voyages verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v13 stage 1: onset_day/departure_day dropped, introduction age drawn from the profile's incubation distribution, 168 epochs, no interventions, molecular_ascertainment_start_day dropped. Carried: imports 1, dwell_weighted sanitary visits.
thetas_note: The five v13 admissible interior points verbatim -- the question is how the measured band points move under each fraction, not where the new edges sit.
infection_age_note: Placeholder required by the cell enumeration grammar, verbatim from v13: under generic mode the import's age is drawn per voyage and age0d carries no meaning.
seeds_note: First 50 of the v13 stage-1 seed block (base 20201001) so every fleet cell pairs seed-for-seed with the first 50 v13 cells at the same Theta -- a coarse read by declaration.

arms.note: v13 baseline arm -- seed-for-seed pairing against the v13 stage-1 rows.
50% hard zero -- SENS-ASSAY-V2 arm label verbatim.
75% hard zero -- SENS-ASSAY-V2 arm label verbatim.

cells_note: 5 Thetas x 4 arms x 50 seeds = 1,000 generic cells (~7 min each).

admissibility.note: FROZEN: the fleet_shape_selector numbers are quoted verbatim for reporting only -- no row on this design is admitted or rejected. The readout reports median attack rate, IQR, takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10) per (theta, arm) beside the v13 row, and the paired per-seed deltas between arms.
admissibility.fleet_shape_selector_report_only: median recorded attack rate in [0.0005, 0.008], IQR overlapping [0.0003, 0.015], mean <= 0.06 -- reported as in/out per row arm, never as a selection verdict: the coarse seed count does not re-admit anything.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_susc_pool_v1_fleet, on the same image as the parent design.
execution.canary: First row on all four arms: INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 200 covers Theta 1.78e11 x 4 arms x 50 seeds (cell order point x arm x seed: declared 0-49, f025 50-99, f050 100-149, f075 150-199) -- override-lands proof (spec dump shows each arm's fraction) plus contract integrity. Remaining rows proceed on a clean read per the campaign gate.
execution.report_immediately_if: an arm row's median lands more than one lattice notch from its v13 comparator in the UPWARD direction (fewer susceptibles cannot raise the attack -- a sign flip is a mechanism defect, not a result); a fraction arm's spec dump lacks its secretor_negative_fraction (override did not reach the run spec); or child failure rate exceeds 5%.
